name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Manager | Adoption, Retention, QBRs & Expansion for Field Service and Trade Businesses
summary: Customer success professional who keeps accounts healthy, renewing, and growing. Retained all but one of 15-20 reseller partners at Birdeye by watching utilization and stepping in before risk turned into churn, and onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix. Works directly with field service trade businesses (electrical, plumbing, HVAC) at Solenzo, so I know how those operators think about software, time, and cost.

experience.title: Client Success & Systems (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Own client relationships with service businesses, including electrical, plumbing, and HVAC trade companies, from discovery and onboarding through ongoing support.
Build and run CRM and automation systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot that clients rely on daily, tracking usage and results to spot where they aren't getting full value.
Identify services clients aren't using yet and recommend them where they fit the client's goals, expanding retainer scope.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed ~3 client accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend, delivering QBRs with ROI, CAC, and LTV reporting.

experience.title: Customer Success & Retention (Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding)
bullets: Managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94%).
Monitored partner utilization and health metrics to flag churn risk early and run interventions that kept accounts active.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health so they could show their own clients ongoing value.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 deals averaging ~$22K and reduced handoff errors between sales and delivery.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded 25+ clients per month at 120% of sales and 110% of implementation targets, managing about 25 concurrent onboardings at peak.
Drove a 25% improvement in conversion rates across supported accounts through proactive communication on client goals.
